title: US, China to hold final tariff talks ahead of expected Xi-Trump summit
description: Top US and Chinese negotiators will meet in Washington for final preparatory talks. Discussions will focus on economic and trade issues, including tariffs and artificial intelligence. President Xi Jinping is expected to visit the United States for a summit with President Trump. The two nations are also negotiating a reciprocal tariff reduction framework. This meeting occurs amid new US sanctions on countries buying Russian oil and gas.

title: India, South Africa hold first Army-to-Army Staff Talks, focus on training and capacity building
description: India and South Africa held their first Army-to-Army Staff Talks in New Delhi. Discussions focused on expanding training exchanges and joint capacity building initiatives. South African delegates observed Indian Army's artificial intelligence projects and manufacturing capabilities. This engagement followed a meeting between Prime Ministers Modi and Ramaphosa. Both nations reaffirmed their comprehensive strategic partnership and future cooperation.
